purpose: Bounded feature-supply experiment after human-reviewed discovery; not production promotion or independent accuracy evaluation.
unchanged: inlier, residual and spatial coverage gates
forbidden: changes to original reports or labels

preflight.flat: Must remain unavailable with zero Harris features, without runtime failure.
preflight.conversion: All 256 U8 intensities must map exactly to S16 value multiplied by 16, range 0 through 4080.

execution.scope: Both full clips, only after both preflights pass.

comparison.reference_kind: 35 frozen baseline-derived actual measurement coordinates; not independent ground truth or recall.
comparison.retention: Every reference frame must be detection-ready with a qualified actual dark measurement within 8 native pixels, belonging to one coherent candidate segment/polarity/track identity. Predictions do not count. Candidate ID need not equal baseline ID.
comparison.burst_interpretation: Unknown mixture includes a compact moving feature; state counts are review workload, not false positives.
comparison.runtime: Current-clock cross-run diagnostic only, not controlled speed benchmark. More readiness creates more downstream work.

preflight_revision.failure: Generated 640x480 image yielded a 40x30 smallest pyramid level, violating PVA minimum 32x32; no real video inference ran.
preflight_revision.change: Generated image height512 gives minimum level40x32. Candidate settings, real-video dimensions and quality gates unchanged.

postcheck_revision.change: Compare canonical JSON for source-transform and effective configuration, still fail closed on any changed values. Repeat both clips in a fresh workspace with unchanged feature algorithm and all gates; disclose prior attempt, no selection of better outcome.
